resolutions.researcher_notes: Original cited ref (cgdindia.net) is dead (current_ref, DEAD_LINK). No web.archive.org snapshot needed since three live, independently-originating sources confirm the line is complete/operating: GAIL's own press release (2024-04-05, re a CIDC award for the '718 km long' BGPL project), Business Standard (2024-03-08, PM Modi's 2024-03-09 inauguration), and PNGRB's regulator register (2026-05-31 NGPL-MIS-Report.pdf), which files this authorisation under 'PARTIALLY COMMISSIONED COMMON CARRIER PIPELINE' with 3,289 of 3,546 km operating for the combined Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro-Dhamra-Paradip-Barauni-Guwahati asset. Consistent with Status='operating'. This mirrors the register-crosswalk's own already-staged resolution for this unit (staging/register-crosswalk/staged_resolutions.json); adding the two 2024 news sources on top gives independent, non-register corroboration and lifts the tier to high.

Supports Delayed='yes'. The wiki seed citation to pratidintime.com ('...Complete by April 2021') is a 404 with no Wayback snapshot (checked CDX API, zero captures), so not usable, but fresh search surfaced two independent, directly on-point, verified-live sources: Assam Tribune (published ~one year after the 2024-03-09 PM inauguration) reports the pipeline 'originally scheduled for completion in December 2021' but as of the article date remains incomplete, 'stuck at Panikhaiti' outside Guwahati, with the final Panikhaiti-Noonmati stretch (~2.5-10 km) 'delayed inordinately' due to contractor issues, and cost overrunning from Rs 3,308 crore to Rs 3,992 crore; Deccan Herald independently reports GAIL itself stating the wider Urja Ganga (JHBDPL, of which BGPL is the terminal leg) pipeline completion was delayed to March 2025. Both explicitly document schedule slippage (original 2021 target vs. still-incomplete 2025), which supports Delayed='yes' regardless of DelayType='inferred' (the GEM classification of how the delay was determined, not a claim the sources must themselves make in those words).

DISAGREEMENT, not a citation gap — do not fill. The recorded value is Capacity=4.38 bcm/y (~12.0 MMSCMD). The only segment-specific figure found is a GAIL/executing-company official quoted by Business Standard (2024-03-08, url_verifier OK): the 24-inch pipeline 'has the capacity to transport around 2.5 MMSCMD of natural gas' (~0.91 bcm/y) — roughly 4.8x lower than the sheet value, and that same '24-inch/2.5 MMSCMD' phrasing recurs in wire-syndicated coverage (single origin, not a second independent figure). PNGRB's 2026-05-31 register lists 23.0 MMSCMD design/determined capacity, but that covers the WHOLE combined 3,546 km Jagdishpur-Haldia-Bokaro-Dhamra-Paradip-Barauni-Guwahati system, not the 718 km BGPL leg alone, so it is not comparable and not used to adjudicate either way. Per the deep-sweep audit shard (rows/P0907.json) this exact conflict was already flagged as a 'spec' concern, routed to Update, not filled here. Searched: GAIL annual reports (no BGPL-specific capacity table found), PIB/PNGRB press material, Assam Tribune/Deccan Herald delay coverage (operational status only, no capacity figure).

Supports StartLocation=Barauni (Bihar) / EndLocation=Guwahati (Assam). GAIL's own 2024-04-05 press release and Business Standard's 2024-03-08 pre-inauguration report both name Barauni (Bihar) as the origin and Guwahati (Assam) as the terminus of the 718 km BGPL line, consistent with the PNGRB register's state list for the combined authorisation (UP, BR/Bihar, JH, WB, OD & AS/Assam). Two independent origins (GAIL company source; Business Standard press coverage) both verified live and containing 'Barauni', 'Guwahati', 'Bihar' and 'Assam'.

DISAGREEMENT, not a citation gap — do not fill. The recorded value is Owner1='Assam Gas Co Ltd' 100%. Every independent source found that names an owner/builder names GAIL (India) Ltd instead: GAIL's own 2024-04-05 press release, Business Standard (2024-03-08, 'a top official of the executing company, GAIL (India) Ltd'), Indian Infrastructure (2024-03-15, 'developed by GAIL (India) Limited'), and PNGRB's own regulatory register (2026-05-31 edition, entity='GAIL' for the combined authorisation). No source found names Assam Gas Co Ltd (AGCL) as owner/builder of this specific line. This exact conflict is already flagged as a high-tier attribution concern in both the register-crosswalk (staging/register-crosswalk/staged_resolutions.json) and the deep-sweep audit shard (rows/P0907.json), both recommending Owner1 be corrected to GAIL (India) Ltd via Update — routed there, not proposed as a ref for the current (likely wrong) value here, per the standing rule against citing sources for a different value than what's recorded.
